Congress Alleges Electoral Roll Irregularities, Seeks Supreme Court Intervention

The Congress party has accused the Election Commission of India (ECI) of making 'illegal' changes to Form 6, a document used for voter registration. The party is seeking action from the Supreme Court regarding these alleged irregularities. Separately, a Delhi court has requested a fresh action taken report on a plea that also alleges electoral roll irregularities by the ECI.
